query_normalized: robustness of change‑point detection methods on public financial time series statistics
rationale: This paper satisfies criteria (a) and (b) as it directly measures the performance and robustness of a specific change-point detection method (CBOCPD) on real-world time series data, which constitutes the core mechanism and domain of the user's inquiry, even though the specific "public financial" subset is not explicitly named in the abstract.
